title: Structuring and Designing Organizations

mc.q: All of the following are part of the process of organizational design EXCEPT ________.
o: deciding how specialized jobs should be
determining the level at which decisions are made

mc.q: Which one of the following pairs include items that are NOT basic elements of organizational design?
Which one of the following is synonymous with work specialization?
Which statement accurately defines work specialization?
o: It is the degree to which tasks are grouped together.
Individual employees specialize in doing part of an activity rather than the entire activity.
Jobs are ranked relative only to their worth or value to the businesses.
Work specialization clarifies who reports to whom.

mc.q: Early supporters of work specialization saw it as ________.
o: a reliable way to increase productivity
a good way to increase employee morale
an immoral way to coerce workers into greater productivity

mc.q: Early users of work specialization in the early twentieth century found that the practice ultimately resulted in ________.
o: higher profits and better employee morale

mc.q: Today, managers favor this approach with regard to work specialization.
o: All tasks are performed by all employees to promote fairness.
Partners switch jobs every half hour to overcome boredom.
Monotonous tasks are shared by all employees to prevent perceived favoritism.

mc.q: Functional departmentalization groups jobs by ________.
o: products or services they manufacture or produce

mc.q: A soap company that features a bath soap department, a laundry detergent department, and a dish soap department is using which one of the following?

What kind of departmentalization would be in place in a government agency in which there are separate departments that provide services for employers, employed workers, unemployed workers, and the disabled?
Health clinic offices usually use this kind of departmentalization.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Process departmentalization groups jobs on the basis of product or customer flow – patients move through registration, examination, lab, billing. Somewhat debatable – please double-check with your instructor.

mc.q: The chain of command answers this question.
o: Where do I go for help?
How do I know when the task is complete?
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Chain of command = line of authority that clarifies who reports to whom.

mc.q: In the chain of command, each person above you ________.
o: has no right to give you orders
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Line authority entitles a manager to direct the work of subordinates.

mc.q: Staff managers have authority over ________.
o: the person above them in the chain of command
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Staff authority supports, assists and advises line managers; staff managers only direct their own support staff.

mc.q: Line authority gives a manager the ability to direct the work of ________.
o: any subordinate, after consulting with the next higher level

mc.q: ________ prevents a single employee from getting conflicting orders from two different superiors.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Unity of command: each person reports to only one manager.

mc.q: The importance of unity of command has diminished in today's workplace because of its tendency to be ________.
Which one of the following statements is true?
o: Authority is one's ability to influence decisions.
Both power and authority are rights.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Authority is a right (based on position); power is a capacity to influence decisions.

mc.q: The personal assistant of a top manager may have ________.
o: line authority but not staff authority
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Being close to the top (power cone) gives influence without formal authority.

mc.q: Which one of the following statements is true?
o: Power is a type of authority.
Authority is a type of power.
Power is determined by horizontal position in an organization.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Authority is one part of the broader concept of power.

mc.q: As represented in a power cone, power is based on ________.
o: vertical position and distance from the center

mc.q: As represented in a hierarchical organization diagram, authority is based on ________.
A construction site supervisor who sees an impending thunderstorm and tells workers to go home is demonstrating ________.
________ is the power that rests on the leader's ability to punish or control.
A bank manager who passes out bonuses at the end of the year is exercising this.
Your firm's attorney has ________ power when giving legal advice.
________ is the power that arises when a person is close to another person who has great power and authority.
When a top manager decides to hire an individual over the objections of her staff, she is exercising which kind of power?
Modern managers find that they can ________ if their employees are experienced, well-trained, and motivated.
A ________ subcontracts part of a project to outside suppliers.
A building contractor follows the network organization model when he does which one of the following?
o: does the framing and tiling by himself
hires three workers to help with framing
farms out the plumbing to a plumbing firm

mc.q: Eric, who is trained as an engineer, is now in a group with production workers and marketing specialists from different departments designing a new product that the company plans to offer. This situation could be described as a(n) ________.
Which one of the following is the biggest concern when doing work at anytime and anywhere?
mc.note: CORRECTED: C is circled on the sheet. The textbook names security (protecting the company's important and sensitive information) as the biggest concern of anytime/anywhere work. Please double-check with your instructor.

mc.q: Global competition forces firms to ________.
A learning organization develops the capability to ________.
o: add new training programs to keep employees up to date
accept the conventional wisdom of the industry
attract new employees who have special knowledge

mc.q: A learning organization requires employees to ________.
o: encode information to prevent competitors from stealing ideas
share information and collaborate with one another

mc.q: All of the following are characteristic of learning organizations EXCEPT ________.
Organizational learning can't take place without ________.
In a learning organization, it is important that all employees ________.
o: have a strong sense of leadership
share the same vision for the organization
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Answer confirmed in class: collaborate.

mc.q: Organizational design requires a manager to ________.
o: decide who leads a group within an organization
change the culture of an organization
change or develop the structure of an organization
change the logo of an organization

scenarios.Eric the Redd: Eric Redd graduated from college and was hired by a corporation that manufactured parts for the automotive industry. The employees on the assembly line seemed bored, and their motivation was low. Eric's employer decided to try to reorganize to increase productivity. During his career, Eric will see his job change from an engineer to a more complex job assignment.

open: In a short essay, describe the matrix structure. What are its advantages and disadvantages?
In a short essay, describe a learning organization. What structural aspects does a learning organization need?
